items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
items.summary: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.

items.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
items.summary: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

items.title: Binance hack is cyber war, TRM Labs executive says
items.summary: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

items.title: US 401(k) proposal leaves door open to altcoins, but hurdles remain
items.summary: While the proposal doesn't exclude altcoins and smaller cryptocurrencies, experts say they could face challenges getting into retirement plans.

items.title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
items.summary: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

items.title: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
items.summary: FinCEN's order, part of Operation Economic Outcast, bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia.

items.title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
items.summary: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a 500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.

items.title: Why a Hyperliquid Treasury Firm Wants to Become a US Futures Broker
items.summary: Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a U.S. futures commission merchant, a move that could let Americans trade perpetual futures on permissioned Hyperliquid markets, pending regulatory approval.

items.title: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears
items.summary: Savers locked out of Ueno Bank burned their cards, booed a former presidential candidate out of the crowd, and watched Congress move to remove President Pena.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
items.summary: Fidelity and BlackRock led Thursday's Bitcoin ETF withdrawals as a technology-stock selloff rattled risk assets.

items.title: US Sanctions 45 More Targets Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam Empire Prince Group
items.summary: OFAC targeted offshore companies and associates it says helped Prince Group executives hide assets and dodge earlier sanctions.

items.title: Treasury cuts off MEXC Global over alleged $16 billion in transactions linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia
items.summary: Treasury says it has severed MEXC Global from the U.S. after it allegedly supported $16 billion in transactions connected to Iran.

items.title: US Treasury walks back crypto surveillance travel rule proposal
items.summary: The Treasury Department has withdrawn a controversial proposal that would have expanded requirements for cryptocurrency transactions.

items.title: Gnosis Pay data breach exposes customer info; funds unaffected
items.summary: Gnosis Pay disclosed a data breach after unauthorized access to its legacy debit card system on Nov. 3. Customer funds were not affected.

items.title: Elliptic says Binance hackers swapped stolen tokens for $124M in bitcoin, exchange plans more withdrawal reopenings
items.summary: Elliptic says little of the stolen crypto has likely been cashed out, while $2.85 billion remains frozen.

items.title: Strive's bitcoin gains drive $509 million Q3 profit as BTC buying ramps up
items.summary: Strive's bitcoin stash reached 43,124 BTC as its shares continued to slide despite a profitable third quarter.

items.title: Trump administration moves closer to allowing crypto in 401(k) retirement plans
items.summary: A rule that would open up 401(k) retirement accounts to alternative assets, including cryptocurrencies, has landed at the White House.

items.title: Ardoino's 24/7 asset plan depends on buyers willing to wait for cash
items.summary: Hadron's RedStone agreement relies on approved buyers to finance fast settlement, while near-instant voluntary holder exits remain on the roadmap.

items.title: Greece ends years of crypto tax uncertainty with new 10% levy on Bitcoin profits
items.summary: Annual gains up to EUR500 are exempt under the approved bill, while directives on transparency and audits are still forthcoming.

items.title: Ethereum software bug triggers emergency fixes across major layer-2 networks
items.summary: Published fixes span several software lines, but they do not establish operator adoption or the status of every cross-chain route.

items.title: Bitcoin miner IREN's AI revenue milestone slips into 2027 as expansion seeks $6 billion
items.summary: Conditional funding covers IREN's initial 0.3GW AI program, while wider FY27 expansion still targets $6 billion of additional financing.

items.title: Binance cuts off trading platform SignalPlus after hackers break in with a fake Teams invite
items.summary: SignalPlus later reported an attack, losses below $82,000 and reimbursement underway, while Deribit also disabled connected keys.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs bought nearly twice what miners produced in Q3-but $430 million left on Thursday
items.summary: Concentrated Q3 buying and falling older-holder balances leave sustained absorption unproven as November withdrawals meet the next US jobs report.
